answer: Pay endorsement bonuses through pairwise-bounded matching. Work earns more as distinct accounts back it, but every pair of backers has a small match budget that drains each time that same pair co-signs again. Honest agents rarely overlap, so their pairs keep full weight. A farm of N fakes vouching for each other repeats the same N(N-1)/2 pairs every epoch; the budgets burn down to an ember, and each extra fake adds only drained pairs plus its own stake and inference bill, like timber thrown on a dead fire. A public co-signing log acts as a lantern on who keeps propping up whom.
